set.body:
Work key: SITE01.1
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product owner with institutional operator and curator
Program scope: required

Scope: After the local demonstration is ready, identify the real pilot sponsor and accountable staff through explicitly authorized institutional discussions; no institution has approved a pilot yet.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Record the institution and named service owner, curator, operator, identity contact and independent access reviewer; confirmation must come from those people, not inferred availability.
2. Confirm the one-institution/multiple-labs/external-collaborator model and document support hours, escalation ownership and permission to use the selected staging environment.
3. Keep unanswered assignments explicitly open; engineering work using the recorded default model can continue independently.

Verification: Retain an owner/decision register with dates and evidence of acceptance; redact contact or account details where required.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/SITE01.1/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

External inputs:
- Institutional sponsor and accountable staff

References:
- docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md#1-what-we-can-responsibly-stand-up
- docs/prd.md
- docs/local-demo-plan.md

Blocked by:
- L01: bd-01M4X5M9Y1A8NCC8SRECRA62AE

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: SITE01.1: Name the pilot institution, service owner and acceptance roles
